description.text: Training Target The major of financial management has given full play to the advantages of the self-study examination of higher education in our country, and at the same time absorbs new knowledge and methods in the related fields of the west, and mainly fostering and bringing up the financial management of adapting to the needs of the development of the socialist market economy, having both ability and ability, and having a certain sense of innovation, innovation and practical work. Sexual and professional professionals. Training requirements This major student mainly studies basic theories and basic knowledge of monetary banking, international finance, securities, investment, insurance and so on. It is basically trained in related business and has the basic ability of practical work in the financial field. main courses Major economics courses: political economics, western economics, finance, international economics, monetary banking, international financial management, securities investment, insurance, commercial bank business management, central bank business, investment bank theory and practice. Future Career With China's entry into the WTO, China's reform in the field of business is becoming more and more adapted to the trend of the times. Therefore, the management departments of foreign business, transnational corporations, foreign enterprises, import and export companies, all kinds of enterprises and enterprises have more and more requirements for financial and financial management personnel. This kind of talent has a big gap and a good salary. After graduation, students are suitable for financial, financial, audit, organization and management in multinational companies, foreign enterprises, import and export companies, financial institutions and enterprises and institutions. Duration: 4 years

duration.text: The Financial Management at Bohai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport 1). The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2). Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
